question: What is net income (loss) for the most recent fiscal year?
rationale: Two-rule set. rule_income_statement_table is layout-aware: for filings with a parent-attribution breakdown it returns focused MD&A summary spans naming 'net (income|earnings) attributable to <parent>' (excluding full income statements that include 'Cost of sales' and sub-entity statements like Obligor Group/Deed of Cross Guarantee); for simpler filings it falls back to the Consolidated Statements of Operations/Income/Earnings table. rule_mda_net_income_summary adds JNJ-style MD&A tables headlined '(Dollars In Billions)' so the QA emits the figure in billions, fixing the JNJ unit mismatch. The remaining miss is BESTBUY_2015_10K, whose gold is 'Net earnings from continuing operations' ($1,246M) — an unusual choice the QA agent consistently bypasses in favor of the 'Net earnings attributable to shareholders' line ($1,233M); a targeted 'continuing operations' MD&A rule (probed) did not shift the QA, so it was dropped to keep |R| minimal.
